description: Implement the Step-owned optional Error Handling Unit callable executing authorized handling operations against target occurrences/resources, producing THandlingOperationResult values until publication acceptance/custody transfer. Implement ErrorHandlerResult aggregate, OperationEntryPublisher reserve/publish/status/release protocol with atomic acceptance, PublicationReservation single-use capability, and Recovery Owner for ambiguous-acceptance escrow.
acceptanceCriteria: Error Handling Unit performs handling operations and produces THandlingOperationResult
OperationEntryPublisher atomic acceptance linearization point implemented
PublicationReservation states Reserved/Consumed/Released with forbidden transitions
ErrorHandlerResult aggregate of operation entries with target occurrence references
Recovery Owner named with ambiguous-acceptance escrow procedure
definitionOfDone: Atomic acceptance tests (no partial acceptance, no duplicate entry)
Architecture test: no ErrorResult containment by ErrorHandlerResult
testStrategy: Publisher protocol tests; atomic acceptance tests; custody transfer tests; architecture boundary tests
